scalars.scalar_value: RECRUITMENT PERIOD ONE MONTH: Applicants will be screened after on a weekly basis.  The position can be filled prior to the apply by date.
Experience catheterizing blood vessels and urinary track.
Experience working in a small animal hospital as a veterinary technician or veterinary assistance.
Days will vary, it will vary between 15:30-24:00 and 23:30-08:00.

items.item_text: Must obtain a Veterinary Assistant Controlled Substance Permit (VACSP) within 3 months from date of hire.
Current California Registered Veterinary Technician (RVT) license.
Experience working in a small animal hospital as a veterinary technician or veterinary assistance.
Experience catheterizing blood vessels and urinary track.

Under supervision of the Small Animal Patient Care shift supervisor, provide Para veterinary technical support to the Small Animal Clinic Veterinarians. On a daily basis, responsible for the treatment of patients, blood bank support, student instruction, clinician support and facility support.
Interpersonal skills to work with a diverse group of people including clients, clinicians, students and staff.
Knowledge of common hospital pathogens and methods of disinfection.
Knowledge of medical terminology and disease processes. Skill to assist in the performance of veterinary medical treatments and procedures.
